recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-wide shot of five men in 1970s attire standing beneath a dark, curved fabric awning of a city building. The scene is characterized by a warm, slightly desaturated color palette and a gritty urban texture, with the subjects arranged in a loose horizontal line.
coreVisualRelationships: The awning acts as a framing device for the central figures.
The vertical lines of the awning poles anchor the composition on the left and right.
The subjects' varied textures (leather, denim, fur) contrast with the flat stone background.
The typography is integrated into the architectural elements of the scene.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five full-length figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy awning at the top center provides a weighted anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text on the awning, moves down through the secondary text, and settles on the faces of the group members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is densely packed with architectural and human detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earth tones (browns, tans, ochre) provide the base atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the leather jackets and awning shadows create depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blues from denim and white highlights in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high-contrast value range, typical of 1970s film stock.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic modern colors
Limit palette to organic, desaturated tones

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses a flared, decorative serif with sharp terminals.
Bottom text uses an ultra-heavy, high-contrast sans-serif with minimal counters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' in the top line features an elongated, sweeping tail.
The 'O' and 'U' in the bottom line are extremely compressed with thick vertical strokes.

composition.warp: slight arch to match awning curve

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a delicate, flared serif with a brutalist, heavy sans-serif.

preserve: The arched baseline of the top text
The extreme weight of the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar flared serifs and 1970s feel for the top text.
Captures the heavy, condensed weight required for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, 1970s-style photograph of five men in vintage street clothes (bell-bottoms, leather jackets, long hair) standing under a dark brown fabric awning in a city alleyway. The lighting should be warm and slightly hazy.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the top display text in a white flared serif, arched to follow the awning's curve. Place the secondary text in a heavy, white, condensed sans-serif directly below the awning edge.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and period-appropriate?
Does the top text follow the physical curve of the awning?
Are the clothing textures (leather, denim) distinct?

adjustableVariables: Specific clothing items (e.g., swapping leather for denim)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Integration of type into the environment

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the color palette remains in the warm earth-tone range
Confirm the typography has a physical, printed-on-surface quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Band Portrait = [1970s Street Photography] + [Architectural Framing (Awning)] + [High-Contrast Vintage Typography] + [Earth-Tone Palette]
